$schema_note: Machine-readable style for the renderer. The renderer reads style ONLY from here (no hardcoded values). Units: px are at the 1080x1920 output; times in seconds; colours hex. Each value carries its measurement source in style/STYLE.md. 'looks' are the three visual families found in the references; scenes pick one (default_look).

safe_area._note: Instagram Reels UI: top bar, bottom caption/username, right action column. Reference titles sit at y 0.13-0.22 of height (250-420 px), CTA pill top at ~0.07-0.12.

grade._measured: Lab (OpenCV 8-bit) of the map inside the subject area, r1 + r6 + r2 frames, overlays excluded: an olive-grey, slightly green/yellow satellite look. The grade transfers the imagery's colour statistics onto these.
grade._calibrated: compare_v5 Lab check (inside crop) at 1.5/5.0/8.6 s: ours was L -11..-19, a +1.5, b +2 vs r1 -> target lifted and greener
grade._calibrated2: inside-subject Lab at 1.5/5/6.8/9.8 s: a,b matched; L std ours 41-43 vs r1 27-31 (too contrasty) and L mean 5-16 low -> std 29, mean 125

focus_dim._measured_outside: frame bottom band Lab L 43 vs subject 106 (outside ~0.41 of inside, dim + vignette together)
focus_dim._measured: r1: everything outside the city boundary is darker; r2: outside the NYC boroughs
focus_dim._calibrated: compare_v2 vs r1: the subject's edge is crisp (the city shape reads clearly), outside uniformly dark
focus_dim._calibrated2: bottom band L: r1 45/49/59 vs ours 35/47/52 at 0.5 -> 0.56
focus_dim._calibrated3: after the contrast fix the bottom band was L 50-66 vs r1 45-59 -> 0.50

vignette._calibrated: 0.45 x the measured rings: the rings were measured on frames that already include the outside dim

region_tint._measured: r2: highlighted region is the satellite image tinted blue (texture stays visible), sampled #0F688E-#1689B8

lift._user: 2026-10-19 user: the place being talked about (Gurugram) looks slightly elevated in the reference - soft shadow outside its edge (down-right) and a light rim

route._measured: stroke 9.6-10.1 px at 720 wide (r1, r6) = 14-15 px at 1080; colours = median core pixels

road_style._measured: r1 ~32 s: Dwarka Expressway as a white dashed line, thinner than the metro lines

label_pill._measured: r1/r6 station labels: yellow box, black text, small pointer under it
label_pill._calibrated: compare_full_d: r1 'Old Gurgaon' pill ~0.24 of the width vs ours 0.13 at 22 px

title._measured: r2 'New york' / 'Metro' (27 / 48 px glyph height at 1920 -> font ~40 / ~72); r6 'Pink line' white, cy 0.18, slowly scales up

title_on_map._measured: r1 'Rapid Metro' white bold over the map, above the route, from ~0.3 s
title_on_map._calibrated: 'Rapid Metro' spans ~0.33 of the width at 0.3 s and grows with the zoom

outline._measured: side-by-side 6.8 s: r1 text has a dark halo/outline around every glyph (makes it pop off the map)

stat._calibrated: text lives on the map and scales with the zoom (r1: '11 Stations' 0.16 of width when it appears at 2.6 s, 0.27 at 5.0 s, 0.33 at 6.5 s). Sizes are px at the moment the text appears.
stat._measured: r1 '11 Stations' yellow + '11.7 KM' green (glyph h 72 px at 1920); r6 '45 Stations' #EFCE20 + '71.5 KM' #2EF728; r2 stat words white with yellow numbers
stat._measured_5s: r1 at 5.0 s: '11 Stations' glyph height 36 px / width 299 px; '11.7 KM' 66 px / 308 px; block centre x 0.39, lines at y 0.45 and 0.51

keyword._measured: r1 6.5 s: 'ELEV(ATED)' small white caps under the station count, typed on 'elevated'
keyword._calibrated: side-by-side 6.8 s: 'ELEVATED' cap height ~half of '11 Stations'

stat._calibrated2: compare_v5 at 5.0 s: '11.7 KM' 309x66 px = r1 308x66 (exact); '11 Stations' 264x32 vs 299x36 -> label x1.13

outline._measured: side-by-side 6.8 s: r1 text has a dark halo/outline around every glyph (makes it pop off the map)

stat._size_model: sizes are px in the view the camera settles into (r1 at 5.0 s: '11 Stations' ~51 px font, '11.7 KM' ~90, 'ELEVATED' ~37); text is anchored to the map, so it reads smaller while the camera is still zooming in and grows into these sizes

stat_inline._measured: r2 '25 Subway Services / 472 Metro Stations / 399 KM': numbers yellow, words white, regular weight

grade._measured: basemap mean brightness 0.30-0.41, saturation 0.59-0.62: vivid, untouched satellite

region_fill._measured: r4 India #008BFE (exact); states and continents flat saturated fills; r3 continents with thin red outline + glow; country names white caps

route._measured: r4 NH44: thin dark dotted line along the highway

big_text._measured: r4 'NH 44' rotated along the route, 'WORLD' + red ribbon '22nd longest highway'

grade._measured: basemap mean brightness 0.18, saturation 0.07: greyscale terrain relief

region_fill._measured: r5 Sikkim neon green #25B928-#33D03C with wide outer glow; districts in flat categorical fills

headline._measured: r5 'WORLD'S FIRST ORGANIC STATE' bold italic serif, green / white / lime words

fonts._note: Reference look A uses Apple SF Pro (licence limits it to Apple-platform UI work), so the free Inter (OFL) stands in; look B is Poppins (OFL); look C headline is a bold italic display serif, Playfair Display (OFL) is the closest free match. If the editor's actual font files are put in inputs/assets/fonts, they replace these.
fonts._tracking: SF Pro sets tighter than Inter: negative tracking (em) makes Inter match the reference widths

text_in._measured: sync strips: text starts 0.0-0.2 s after the word onset, characters revealed left->right, complete ~0.4 s later

label_in._measured: r1 'Millennium City' pill appears +0.2 s and grows

fill_in._measured: r4 states pop instantly one by one on each spoken name; r2/r5 fade

route_draw._measured: r6 Pink line draws in ~1.2 s from frame 0; r1 Yellow Line ~1 s
route_draw._user_feedback: 2026-10-19 user: lines drew too fast (1.1 s easeOutCubic shot out at the start) -> 2.0 s, gentle start and finish

camera._measured_lead: move start minus nearest word start: median 0.02 s over 37 moves (r2-r5); range -0.3..+0.25

metro_dark._measured: r1/r6 moves: zoom x1.2-2.0 over 3.5-6.5 s, progress at 50% time = 0.56-0.75 (near-linear with a soft ease-out); camera keeps drifting between moves
metro_dark._ease_fix: easeOutSine starts at full speed: our test render jolted (zoom step 0.0064 vs median 0.0003 at 0.85 s). softOutSine ramps from zero.

bright_political._measured: r4: 8/13 moves best fit easeInOutSine, 1.6-3 s

hillshade_glow._measured: r5: punch-ins, 50% of the zoom done in the first 20-25% of the move

plan._note: How the planner turns entities into camera moves and overlays. Fractions are of the 1080x1920 frame.

fit._measured: r1: Gurugram fills ~0.75 of the width at t=0; Rapid Metro spans ~0.45 of the height at t=6
fit._calibrated: r1 at 0.3 s: Gurugram ~0.56 of the width (compare_v4); at 1.5 s ~0.5

plan._subject_with_stats_x: r1 at 5-6.5 s: Rapid Metro at ~0.62 of the width, '11 Stations / 11.7 KM' centred at ~0.38
plan._calibrated_v6: compare_v6: keyword 17->28 px, line centres 0.088H->0.06H (gap 0.006), first view city 0.40->0.56 width (fit 0.68)
plan._stops_margin: compare_full_e: 'Cyber City' label cut at the frame edge at 33 s -> 12 % room around a line's stops

facecam._measured: r1, r2, r5, r6: last 12-17 s are the creator on camera; r3 intercuts 1.5-6 s face-cam bits through the reel; r4 has none

broll._measured: r2 subway footage full-frame with the spoken stat on top; r5 farm photos as stacked rounded cards with a soft green glow

edit.hook: subject on screen from frame 0, camera already moving, title types in by 0.2-0.5 s; no title card

comment_pill._measured: r4 last ~3 s, over the map

voice._measured: integrated -14.1..-14.3 LUFS, LRA 1.1-3.1 LU on all six reels

music_bed._measured: r2, r6: no bed (no energy under 90 Hz); r1, r4, r5: a quiet bed; level to be set by ear against r1/r4

sfx._measured: no whoosh/pop on every zoom; r3 uses a few bass impacts on reveals

branding._measured: only r5 shows '@creator.adarshh' (small, ~35% opacity); others none

captions._measured: no running subtitles in any reference; only keyword / number / place popups

punch._measured: reference face-cam: punch-in cuts x1.21-1.6 and back out every 3-7 s (r1 45.1/48.4, r2 41.9/44.2, r6 37.8-45.4)
punch._user: 2026-10-19 user: too many cuts on the face-cam, uncomfortable frame by frame (we had 6 cuts in 17 s, two pairs 0.3-0.6 s apart: ours next to the clip's own) -> 5-7 s apart and never within 2.5 s of a cut already in the clip

facecam._push: slow push-in between cuts; reference segments drift x1.3-1.5 over 7-17 s

grade._user: 2026-10-19 user: face-cam looked flat/boring ('fiki'); mild contrast + colour + vignette

follow_button._measured: r5 face-cam outro: blue 'Follow' pill button pops in; r3: 'Creator.adarsh Follow' pill

comment_button._measured: r5: gradient COMMENT button before Follow

stat_box._user: facecam check: yellow text on the white wall was unreadable and sat on the head -> bigger, dark rounded backdrop, top third

facecam._stat_y: facecam_check3: even below-the-chin placement hit the beard in a deep close-up; a fixed lower-third band (0.70, above the IG bottom UI) never covers the face
